# The Wavy Society

> $WAVY is a community utility token on Base. Holders unlock private marketplaces and a life-operations system that turns real money goals into one confirmed action. The token has not launched: there is no contract address, no price, and no market. The planned launch standard is Bankr Doppler on Base — 100B fixed supply, 85% liquidity, 15% creator vesting over 1 year with a 30-day cliff. Presale payments land in the Treasury Safe on Base.

The Wavy Society is a pre-launch community on Base. Membership bestows entry to private marketplaces and a life-operations service that turns real money goals into one confirmed action, with the member's consent, guardian rules, and allowlisted exits. The Ship's Store (memorabilia presale) is open; the Life Ledger is a preview and is not connected. Founded 2026. Contact: https://wavysociety.pages.dev
